tasks.title: Tigers
tasks.instruction: Fill in the missing letters in the paragraph.
tasks.translation: 老虎是独居动物，以领地行为著称；雄性用气味标记和叫声划定领地。每只雄虎控制着数平方英里的大片领地，并定期巡视以寻找猎物、维持主导地位。这种行为有助于减少因猎物产生的冲突，但必要时老虎会猛烈抵御入侵者。它们常在夜间狩猎，借助隐蔽和出色的夜视能力。

passage.t: Tigers are solitary animals known for their territorial behavior; males use scent markings and vocalizations to define their territories. Each

for prey and maintain dominance. This behavior helps reduce conflicts over prey, but tigers are known to fiercely defend their territory from intruders when necessary. Often hunting at night, tigers use stealth and their excellent night vision to their advantage.

layout.title: Introduction to Glassblowing
layout.body:
This hands-on class introduces adults (18+) to the art of glassblowing. You'll learn safety, shaping, and design techniques while crafting your own unique work of glass art.

No experience needed — just curiosity and closed-toe shoes! Other safety-related equipment will be provided by the instructor.

Register now — spaces are limited!
Visit www.alburcommunitycenter.com/glassblowing.

questions.stem: Who can register for the course?

options.A: Anyone who is at least 18 years old
options.B: Anyone who has worked with glass before
options.C: Anyone who has read a book on glass art
options.D: Anyone who is registered for classes at a university

questions.analysis: 课程写 adults (18+)，年满 18 岁即可报名。

questions.stem: It can be inferred that students should wear closed-toe shoes because

options.A: they are preferred by the instructor
options.B: they offer protection during the process
options.C: they are unique to the Albur community
options.D: they help reduce the risk of falling

questions.analysis: 与 safety-related equipment 并列，闭口鞋是保护。

tasks.title: Augmented Reality in Training
tasks.translation: 增强现实（AR）已成为人类绩效技术、尤其是培训领域的突破性工具。AR 将数字信息叠加到现实世界，提供沉浸式体验，促进学习与技能习得。例如，AR 可模拟复杂机械操作，让学员像亲临现场一样与虚拟部件互动。这种动手方式帮助学习者理解复杂流程，同时避免真实操作的风险。AR 的适应性使其适用于多个行业。医学中可投射人体解剖三维模型，引导外科医生完成复杂手术；航空中飞行员用 AR 练习应急程序，获得安全而真实的训练环境。研究表明这些应用显著提高记忆保持与表现。AR 还能按个人需求定制场景。但把 AR 纳入培训也面临挑战：硬件与软件投入巨大，制作准确、响应迅速的内容需要许多机构尚不具备的专业能力。尽管如此，AR 对提升人类绩效的益处毋庸置疑。随着技术演进，它有望提供更精密有效的培训方案。
paras: Augmented reality (AR) has emerged as a groundbreaking tool in the field of human performance technology, particularly in training environments. AR overlays digital information on the real world, providing immersive experiences that enhance learning and skill acquisition. For example, AR can simulate complex machinery operations, allowing trainees to interact with virtual components as if they were physically present. This hands-on approach helps learners understand intricate processes without the risks associated with real-world practice.

The adaptability of AR makes it suitable for various industries. In medicine, AR can project 3D models of human anatomy, guiding surgeons through complex procedures. In aviation, pilots use AR to practice emergency protocols, offering a safe yet realistic training environment. Studies have shown that these AR applications significantly improve retention rates and performance outcomes. Moreover, AR's ability to customize training scenarios based on individual needs further enhances its effectiveness.

However, integrating AR into training programs presents challenges. The technology requires substantial investment in hardware and software development. Additionally, creating accurate and responsive AR content demands expertise that many organizations may lack. Despite these hurdles, the benefits of AR in boosting human performance are undeniable. As the technology continues to evolve, it promises even more sophisticated and effective training solutions.

questions.stem: The word "groundbreaking" in the passage is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: groundbreaking 意为开创性，最接近 revolutionary。

questions.stem: What is the function of AR as described in the passage?

options.B: AR produces realistic experiences in a learning environment.
options.C: AR enables unskilled humans to interact with complex machines.
options.D: AR produces a digital record of real-world content.

questions.analysis: 原文 providing immersive experiences that enhance learning。

questions.stem: AR reduces which of the following problems associated with traditional training environments?

options.A: Their inability to simulate authentic experiences

questions.analysis: without the risks associated with real-world practice。

questions.stem: Why does the author cite studies showing that AR improves retention rates?

options.A: To demonstrate its usefulness when practicing emergency protocols
options.B: To provide an example of its adaptability
options.C: To explain why fields outside medicine and aviation are slower to adopt it
options.D: To support the claim that it is useful to industries

questions.analysis: 研究用来支撑 these AR applications 对行业培训有效。

questions.stem: What is one problem the passage mentions related to the use of AR?

options.A: The costs associated with making it useful to particular clients
options.B: Disagreement among experts regarding its accuracy
options.C: A lack of measurable benefits in its present stage of development
options.D: The absence of existing training programs into which it may be integrated

questions.analysis: substantial investment in hardware and software；定制内容也费钱费人。
